# Clean the camera window

[All care guides](README.md)

**What it does**

The camera and the sensor windows help the robot find its way. Smudges make it lose its position.

**How to**

1. Find the camera window on top of or at the front of the robot.
2. Wipe it gently with a clean, dry microfibre cloth.
3. Wipe the other sensor windows at the front the same way.

> **Note** No liquids or cleaning agents on the windows.
